notes: no independent per-observation truth exists in this corpus, so signal-level precision/recall are NOT ESTIMABLE rather than assumed

episode-level recall is NOT ESTIMABLE: ground truth names the injected fault, not the number of episodes it should yield. A missed fault appears here as an extra episode (a precision error), not as a missing one. Use RUN-level recall for 'was the fault found'.

incident-level recall is NOT ESTIMABLE: there is no independent truth for how many incidents a fault should produce. `missed_primary_faults` reports the misses explicitly and always equals RUN-level fn.

RUN.precision_denominator: all runs that opened an incident

unit_accounting.explanation: The v0.1.1 scoreboard's 97 records were EPISODES, not runs. A run may hold several episodes, so the same injected fault can appear in more than one classification record. Episode counts must never be read as run counts.
